verdict.rationale: Connecting accounts from several providers is a fair question for an email client, but the pack has no vendor claim of multi-account or cross-provider support. Community and founder statements say Shortwave integrates only with Gmail's APIs and does not support IMAP. Nothing in the pack mentions Microsoft 365 or managing several accounts in one place.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
